column1: # Measured seconds per shell suite, read by tests/lib/shard.py (its docstring holds the format and the rules): each
# entry's load in the full suite's shard split (ADR 0073 d3), so the shards balance on time, not file size.
# Source: the per-suite `<label>: ok (<N>s)` lines of two local `make test` runs (2026-11-09, p43-6's audit,
# docs/audits/2026-11-09-test-suite.md), at the default cap of 4 on a 12-core Mac, load 3 to 5; each value is the
# median of the two. @merge-task-self-tests is its two self-tests summed. A suite that ended within its first
# second (0 s) is written as 0.5, since a weight must be positive.
# Regenerate: run `make test` twice, take each suite's median from those lines, sum the two self-tests, and rewrite
# this file whole. A suite added since falls back to its size times the median seconds per byte (shard.py).
